## Change and expected behavior

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and affected data/model/report versions.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit, contract, quality, ML, integration and fixture end-to-end tests pass
- [ ] Formatting/lint and applicable security/dependency checks pass
- [ ] Documentation/runbook and lineage are updated
- [ ] Contract/schema compatibility and quality rules are reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, private source data, customer exports or model/cache artifacts are included
- [ ] Breaking changes, rollback and operational warnings are identified
- [ ] Synthetic data/model labels and offline-versus-business metrics remain explicit

## Release/rollback

Record the validated environment, release reference, deployment limitations and rollback plan. A local Champion or passing build is not Production approval.
